_comment: Loot tables (ADR 0057). A material with "shatter": "<table>" (materials.gd) breaks at any hit and drops a roll of that table instead of itself: ruin pots today, dungeon chests and urns later. A table: rolls [min, max] picks of its entries (weighted, with replacement), empty_chance = the share of breaks that hold nothing; an entry: id, weight, count n or [min, max], wear [min, max] = share of the item's durability already used (old tools). deeper: {depth_m, table} switches to another table when the break is that far below the surface. The roll is deterministic from the world seed and the piece's lowest voxel.
